recommendation.canonical_fix: Transport and validate the canonical typed effect envelope with generation beside parameters. Derive the remote effect hash from that envelope and pass generation separately to failure context; do not store or admit generation as a second parameter authority field.
recommendation.execution_adapter: All execution paths, including prepared evaluation requests, must parse the outer TypedEffect and use the registered prepare/transport adapter rather than projecting effect.parameters directly.

root_cause.authority_shape: The prepared request correctly stores generation at effect.generation and omits it from effect.parameters.
root_cause.remote_shape: The streamed remote validator incorrectly requires generation inside its flattened parameter object.
root_cause.replay: The exact request has 34 parameters; the remote parser requires the same 34 plus generation, so validation deterministically refuses before provider identity or scratch creation.
root_cause.test_gap: Provider tests supplied the flattened generation field directly and did not exercise projection from the canonical outer effect envelope.
